# HighStreetExpress
> UK's fastest fashion & lifestyle delivery — order in seconds, delivered in 10 minutes.

## About
HighStreetExpress (HSX) is a UK ultra-fast commerce platform delivering premium fashion and lifestyle products to your door in 10 minutes. Founded by Vivek Saxena. Contact: riders@highstreetexpress.com | +44 07818 923405.

## What We Sell
- Premium fashion clothing & accessories
- Lifestyle & home products
- Beauty & personal care
- Gifts & seasonal items

## Why Customers Choose HighStreetExpress
- ⚡ 10-minute delivery — the fastest in the UK
- Free delivery on orders above £20
- Secure payment (Visa, Mastercard and more)
- 30-day hassle-free returns
- Friendly UK-based support team
